spoken_summary: Congressman Maxwell Frost praises President Biden for creating the Office of Gun Violence Prevention, calling the action 'huge.' He explains that the office will collaborate with organizations across the country to develop recommendations, manage funding for community violence intervention programs, and ultimately 'save lives.'
